_comment: Retention for transient run artifacts, enforced by GCS itself.
The prefix MUST match what server/main.py::_publish actually writes, which is
prefix that receives data, never by the presence of a rule: the donor bucket carries
five carefully written rules covering temporary/, incoming/, source-archives/ and
viewer/ -- and none of them matches runs/, which is where its output actually went.
Those objects have no expiry at all.
3 days matches expires_after_days in server/contract.py. That field has advertised a
retention since the contract was written and no code has ever honoured it; this rule
is what turns it from a statement of intent into a guarantee. Change both together.
matchesPrefix has no leading slash -- it is relative to the bucket root.
